skill.name: liepin-cli
skill.description: Use Liepin CLI to search jobs, review resumes, update resume details, and submit confirmed applications on Liepin.
skill.summary: Search Liepin jobs, review resumes, and manage applications through a local CLI.
skill.author: xllin

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real risks from authenticated network calls, environment-token access, plaintext local token configuration, and hidden credential-file use. Many high-looking static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, parameter names, and entropy in readable multilingual text. No prompt injection text was found in the cited files.

remediation.issue: Resume updates and job applications can change a real Liepin account.
remediation.suggestion: Require runtime confirmation before apply or resume update actions, and show the exact job or resume module before executing.

remediation.issue: The user token can be stored in local plaintext configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Use the operating system keychain where possible, set restrictive file permissions, and document the exact token storage path.

remediation.issue: A configured MCP endpoint can receive the user token.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict requests to trusted Liepin endpoints by default and warn users before accepting a custom URL.

remediation.issue: Installation guidance points users to an external repository.
remediation.suggestion: Link to a verified release, pin versions, and provide checksums or signed artifacts for the CLI dependency.

semantic_findings.title: Authenticated Resume and Job Application Side Effects
semantic_findings.description: The skill can fetch resume data, update resume modules, and submit job applications through authenticated MCP calls. SKILL.md requires confirmation before applying, but the Python CLI exposes direct apply and update commands without enforcing chat-level confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly includes resume review and job application, and the implementation directly calls user-apply-job and resume-toolkit. This is intended functionality, but it has real external account effects.

semantic_findings.title: Configurable Endpoint Receives User Token
semantic_findings.description: The MCP URL can be read from configuration or setup arguments, and the client sends the user token in an HTTP header. A malicious or mistaken endpoint override could receive the token and job or resume payloads.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code sets x-user-token on each request and allows the URL to come from configuration or the setup --url argument. The risk depends on endpoint control, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Manage Liepin Jobs from the CLI
content.value_statement: Liepin job workflows can be hard to run from chat because search, resume, and application steps use separate commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the local CLI with structured outputs and confirmation steps.
actual_capabilities: Search Liepin jobs with role, location, salary, education, experience, company type, or company name filters.
Fetch the current Liepin resume and present key fields in a readable summary.
Update supported resume modules through CLI arguments or structured input files.
Apply to jobs with a job ID and job kind returned from search results.
Manage local authentication setup, status checks, authorization refresh, and token clearing.
Request machine-readable CLI output when the user needs parsing or comparison.
limitations: Requires liepin-cli installed and available on PATH before use.
Requires a valid Liepin user token or local authenticated configuration.
Can only act on capabilities exposed by the installed CLI and Liepin MCP service.
Job applications and resume changes affect the real Liepin account and need explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Search Matched Roles
use_cases.description: Find Liepin roles by title, city, salary, experience, education, and company filters, then compare the strongest matches.

use_cases.title: Review Resume Readiness
use_cases.description: Fetch the current Liepin resume, summarize missing sections, and prepare changes before applying to selected roles.

use_cases.title: Run Structured Job Workflows
use_cases.description: Use machine-readable CLI output to parse search results, preserve job kind values, and prepare confirmed application steps.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me check whether Liepin CLI is installed and guide me through authentication without exposing my token.

prompt_templates.title: Search for Jobs
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Liepin for product manager roles in Shanghai, then summarize the most relevant results in a table.

prompt_templates.title: Review Resume Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch my Liepin resume, compare it with the search results, and list gaps I should fix before applying.

prompt_templates.title: Apply with Confirmation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with external account effects.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for senior AI product roles, verify job kind from each result, show the target role details, and ask before applying.

output_examples.input: Search for AI product manager jobs in Shanghai.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of matching roles with company, location, salary range, experience needs, and reasons each role may fit.

output_examples.input: Check whether my resume is ready for these roles.
output_examples.output: A concise resume readiness summary with missing fields, weak sections, and suggested updates before applying.

output_examples.input: Apply to this selected job after I confirm.
output_examples.output: A confirmation request that shows the job title, company, job kind, and account impact before any application is submitted.

best_practices: Confirm the target job details before every application.
Use machine-readable output when comparing multiple jobs or parsing resume fields.
Keep tokens private and use Liepin auth flows instead of pasting secrets into chat.
anti_patterns: Do not guess job kind values; reuse values returned by search.
Do not apply to jobs without clear user confirmation.
Do not expose hidden flags or token values in first-time help.

faq.question: Does this skill install liepin-cli?
faq.answer: No. It guides use of an existing local installation and points users to install documentation if the CLI is missing.

faq.question: Does it need a Liepin token?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI needs a valid Liepin user token or an existing authenticated local configuration.

faq.question: Can it apply to jobs automatically?
faq.answer: It can run application commands, but the skill instructions require explicit confirmation before any application is submitted.

faq.question: Can it update my resume?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide supported resume updates through the CLI, but changes affect the real Liepin profile.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the local CLI is available.

faq.question: Where is authentication stored?
faq.answer: The CLI may use environment variables or a local config file. Treat these tokens as sensitive credentials.
